design_philosophy: Aspirational Wanderlust meets Premium Education Trust. Target is Brazilian/Latino youth (16-30). Blend the editorial elegance of high-end travel (Godly-style) with the approachability and trust of a certified education agency. Avoid corporate sterility. Use magazine-like typography, generous whitespace, and sectioned storytelling.

rules.overline: uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-primary

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 (use generous padding, 2-3x typical)
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for Marketing. Use asymmetrical bento grids for 'Top 5 Destinations' and 'Programs'. Never perfectly symmetrical.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for soft approachability

surfaces_and_effects.hero_overlay: bg-black/30 to bg-black/40 (keep images vibrant and visible)
surfaces_and_effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40 for sticky header
surfaces_and_effects.cards: Flat background (surface_subtle), 1px subtle border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

hero.alt: Sydney Opera House and Skyline at sunset
hero.instructions: Full width hero, minimal overlay (max black/40). Use Cormorant Garamond for the massive H1.

students.instructions: Use in 'Why Choose Us' or 'Testimonials' section as an aspirational anchor.

component_guidelines.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for creative asymmetry. Avoid Shadcn Cards for purely visual layout.
component_guidelines.interactive_elements: Use Shadcn UI for the multi-step Inquiry Form, Datepicker (Consultation Booking), Accordion (FAQ), and Input fields. Strictly customize Shadcn borders and radii to match rounded-2xl style.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky header with Crystal Glass effect. Desktop links must be visible, mobile uses hamburger.
component_guidelines.chatbot: Floating UI widget in bottom right (Shadcn Dialog/Popover) for Claude AI Chatbot.
component_guidelines.whatsapp_button: Sticky floating button on bottom left using brand green or secondary accent (#F59E0B) for high conversion.
component_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Clean layout (Archetype 4 style) specifically for /admin route to view submitted inquiries.

testing_requirements.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, form input, form submit button, accordion, and link MUST have a role-based data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='hero-book-consultation', data-testid='whatsapp-float', data-testid='inquiry-form-submit', data-testid='inquiry-email-input'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full stack hybrid application. Main marketing site features high-end editorial visuals. Use exact media URLs provided above. Integrate a complete multi-step form for lead capture, a calendar/datepicker for consultation, and an admin dashboard to view leads. All interactive components must use data-testid. Font choices must match Cormorant Garamond and Outfit.
